chunks: Still less do they comprehend the life to come. In fact they are in doubt about it. Still more, they are blind to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the progression of disbelievers' state regarding the Hereafter in Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the epistemological failure of the disbelievers, whose knowledge is confined to the material world, leading them from mere doubt to a state of active heedlessness (ghaflah) regarding the unseen. The progression from 'limited knowledge' to 'blindness' underscores the necessity of divine guidance and the intellect (aql) to transcend worldly limitations and grasp the reality of the Hereafter.
